---
name: Sprint work item
about: Define a bounded, verifiable Little Jay backlog item.
---

## Outcome

[Describe the problem, who benefits, and the observable result.
For bugs, include a minimal sanitized reproduction. Never include secrets,
personal data, or security-sensitive details.]

## Tracking

- Stable ID: [existing identifier, or Not applicable for new work]
- Proposed owner: [owning component/workspace; not an assignment]
- Status: [Needs inspection / Ready to scope / In progress / Implemented /
  Deferred / Declined]
- Next action: [smallest concrete next step]

## Scope

- In scope: [bounded change]
- Out of scope: [explicit non-goals]
- Relevant paths/components: [verified starting points]
- Consumer/use case and reuse: [owning screen/source and existing alternatives]

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: [observable behavior, including relevant edge/error cases]

## Dependencies and constraints

- Blocked by: [verified issue links and required deliverables; use Unknown
  with its readiness impact until checked, or None after checking]
- Constraints/shared interfaces: [compatibility, contracts, ordering,
  and application/library boundaries; Not applicable when established]

## Verification

- AC1: [test/manual check and expected evidence]
- Required checks/review: [select applicable requirements from
  docs/VERIFICATION.md; mark anything still needing discovery]

## Open questions

[List unresolved decisions and which block execution, or None when established.
Ready to scope does not authorize implementation. Keep sprint assignments,
ports, worktrees, and progress in the sprint record.]
